design_quote: We searched PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, and the Cochrane Library to identify randomized controlled trials (RCTs) related to the first-line treatment of NSCLC with ICIs alone or in combination with chemotherapy.
k_quote: In total, 28 RCTs involving 14,758 patients were included.
note: PD-L1 vs PD-1 compared across trials (indirect); treated as pairwise MA of RCTs.
